h.Resposta curta: todo iPhone do 7 em dian: Short answer: every iPhone from the 7 onward reads NFC tags like the one in a review stand or card. From the XS/XR onward, it reads them on its own: the customer just brings the top of the phone close, with the screen on, and the link opens. On the 7, 8 and X, you first need to tap a shortcut in Control Center. No app needs to be installed in any case.
h.Esse é o erro número um. No iPhone, a an: This is mistake number one. On the iPhone, the NFC antenna sits at the top edge, near the camera. People used to contactless payments on Android tend to tap the middle of the back of the phone, and then it doesn't read.
h.Frase para ensinar a equipe: \"encosta a: A line to teach your team: "tap the very top of your phone right here". It solves most cases without explaining any technology.
Screen off or locked on a black screen. The screen needs to be on. It doesn't need to be unlocked for the notification to appear, but it does to open the link.
h.Câmera aberta ou Carteira da Apple em us: Camera open or Apple Wallet in use. While the camera is open, the iPhone doesn't read NFC. If the customer opened the camera to scan the QR, just use the QR.
h.Capinha grossa, de metal, ou com cartões: Thick case, metal case, or one with cards inside. A regular silicone case doesn't get in the way. A case with a metal plate (for magnetic mounts) or a wallet case with cards can block it.
h.Adicione \"Leitor de Tags NFC\" (precisa: Add "NFC Tag Reader" (requires iOS 14 or newer).
h.É muito passo para um cliente que está i: That's a lot of steps for a customer who's on their way out. That's why for these models the fastest path is the QR Code, which any camera can read.
h.O NFC precisa estar ligado. Alguns apare: NFC needs to be turned on. Some phones ship with it off. It's in the quick settings panel (swipe down from the top of the screen) or in Settings → Connections.
h.A antena costuma ficar no meio das costa: The antenna is usually in the middle of the back, sometimes a bit higher. If it doesn't open the first time, just move the phone slowly over the stand.
